evidence.title: 《養吉齋叢錄》 on 綺春園 and the Thirty Scenes
evidence.date: Qing; text states events up to 文宗
evidence.excerpt_zh: 綺春園在圓明園東，有複道相屬。舊為大學士傅恆及其子大學士福康安賜園，歿後繳進，嘉慶間始加繕葺。仁宗御製綺春園三十景詩，有宣宗恭跋：先是，園西南以繚垣別界一區，名含暉園，莊敬和碩公主釐降時，賜居於此。公主薨逝，額駙索特那木多布齋以園繳進。舊又橫界一區，名西爽村，有聯暉樓，為成邸寓園。嘉慶間成邸別賜園宅，西爽、含暉皆併入為一園，而規模宏遠矣。舊有數楹名鳳麐洲，後易名清夏齋；問月樓在洲之南，鏡綠亭在洲之北。道光時為尊養孝和皇太后之所，正殿曰迎暉殿。文宗登極，奉康慈太后亦居此，問安視膳，皆如道光間禮。三十景者：敷春堂　鑑德書屋　翠合軒　凌虛閣　協性齋　澄光榭　問月樓　我見室　蔚藻堂　藹芳圃　鏡綠亭　淙玉軒　舒卉軒　竹林院　夕霏榭　清夏齋　鏡虹館　春雨山房　含光樓（即舊時聯暉樓）　涵清館　華滋庭　苔香室　虛明鏡　含淳堂　春澤齋　水心榭　四宜書屋　茗柯精舍　來薰室　般若觀
evidence.summary: The earliest list of the Thirty Scenes we can see, and the history before it seems to come from Daoguang's colophon to Jiaqing's poem set (有宣宗恭跋). It places 問月樓 south of 洲 and 鏡綠亭 north of it, names 迎暉殿 as the main hall of the dowager's residence, and equates 含光樓 with the old 聯暉樓. Punctuation is ours; the print has none. Transcribed by eye.

evidence.title: 春泽斋
evidence.locator: v4 p.274, under 春泽斋; source ref 2-86
evidence.excerpt_zh: 四时首阳春，甘泽敷穹宇。五谷荷滋培，嘉生茂场圃。共沐沾溉恩，顺候协旸雨。有收庆屡丰，率育皆乐土。食足民自安，万井咸和煦。斋额符心祈，敬予吁多祐。
evidence.summary: Poem 春泽斋 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1801, filed by the editors under 春泽斋.

evidence.title: 春泽斋: 嘉庆七年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆七年 (1802), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 三春未沐泽，得雨泽如春。出沐山容净，开奁波影新。化工转旋妙，甘㴻润滋匀。麦熟心诚慰，稍苏穷苦民。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 春泽斋, 1802, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 春泽斋 (绮春园三十景)
evidence.excerpt_zh: 春宇溟蒙云气升，一犂甘泽应休征。敷膏有象繁滋洽，润物无声薄雾凝。既足四郊沛若遍，欣看二麦浡然兴。斋前茂对符楹额，林霭波烟虚槛凭。
evidence.summary: One of the Thirty Scenes of 绮春园 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1805 (S58): the poem 春泽斋.

evidence.title: 春泽斋
evidence.locator: v4 p.279, under 春泽斋; source ref 3-349
evidence.excerpt_zh: 回廊四面绕，石沼印清波。密荫舒高柳，幽香送远荷。林蝉音唱和，汀鹭羽婆娑。纳爽凭朱槛，凉风透薄罗。
evidence.summary: Poem 春泽斋 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1807, filed by the editors under 春泽斋.

evidence.title: 春泽斋
evidence.locator: v4 p.280, under 春泽斋; source ref 4-34
evidence.excerpt_zh: 品汇逢春复起枯，感叨天泽普涵濡。枝柯展拓惠风畅，根本滋培甘雨敷。暖沼浮青虚叠绮，柔莎衬碧润含酥。嘉生繁衍盈原隰，茂对心欣斋额符。
evidence.summary: Poem 春泽斋 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1808, filed by the editors under 春泽斋.

evidence.title: 春泽斋: 嘉庆十三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆十三年 (1808), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 上苍敷恺泽，生物始于春。欲锡蒸民惠，虔希昊縡仁（去冬雪泽未沾时，殷祈盼，兹节候近届立春，惟冀苍仁司契畅敷生物之心，李应虔祈之念，渥施膏泽溥利春耕）。年逢稼穑美，心愿雨旸匀。律转青阳鬯，芳园丽景新。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 春泽斋, 1808, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 春泽斋: 嘉庆十九年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆十九年 (1814), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 元为善长应三春，天泽宏敷惠万民。沟壑自投甘作孽，愧予无德救沉沦。八字邪言惑众心，逞凶作乱堕迷深。有生趋赴无生路，洒泪瞻霄赐鉴临。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 春泽斋, 1814, on state papers. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 春泽斋: 嘉庆二十年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆二十年 (1815), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 上苍德好生，春泽苏万汇。一犁新雨滋，远胜珠玉贵。人性养中和，致祥调六气，感召凛明昭，时刻存敬畏。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 春泽斋, 1815, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 春泽斋: 嘉庆二十二年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆二十二年 (1817), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 一年生计在于春，天泽覃敷养万民。甘雨膏田添浃洽，和风拂树拓轻匀。始青弥觉根荄润，众绿渐看枝叶申。举趾东皋早往岁，屡丰庶可救饥贫。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 春泽斋, 1817, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 春泽斋: 嘉庆二十三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆二十三年 (1818), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 斋名祈副颠，敬待屡丰年。虔俟三春泽，普滋九宇田。政由岁是本，民以食为天。二麦含瑶液，授时东作连。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 春泽斋, 1818, on the harvest. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 春泽斋: 嘉庆二十四年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆二十四年 (1819), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 今春泽透沾，三白正月节。直隶及豫齐，千里被瑞雪。二麦望有收，可补去岁缺。东作利新耕，积润下尺结。敬授感昊慈，君民实亲切，旧欠普蠲除，陬澨胥欢悦。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 春泽斋, 1819, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 题春泽斋
evidence.locator: v4 p.277, under 春泽斋; source ref 3-304
evidence.excerpt_zh: 上苍生物敷春泽，建极钦承被万方。出震调元滋绿甲，乘乾运化启青阳。四时普愿绥丰协，八表还期民物昌。亟待甘膏利东作，殚心农务祝年康。去岁孟冬，渥沾瑞雪。冬月，亦曾继霈祥霙。新年来，青阳入律，春和景明，可验绥丰之象。惟节令已交启蛰，东作方兴。亟望甘膏润物，大益农功。予省岁殷怀，无时或释。此斋额所题，以承生冬之后者，原有取于贞下起元。正如冬玉春膏，循环溥利。拈吟适愿，
evidence.summary: Poem 题春泽斋 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1807, filed by the editors under 春泽斋.

evidence.title: 仲春春泽斋
evidence.locator: v4 p.280, under 春泽斋; source ref 4-10
evidence.excerpt_zh: 天泽覃敷岁始春，敬承图治勉安仁。兆民蒙福闾阎谧，百谷含生旸雨匀。时炫莺花新可喜，政筹雁户旧应循。率由考训期无忝，深愧澨陬化未淳。
evidence.summary: Poem 仲春春泽斋 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1808, filed by the editors under 春泽斋.

evidence.title: Site status table, about 2011: nothing visible, or built over
evidence.summary: Same table. In it the first group shows no visible remains; 得全阁, 流香渚, 凤麟洲, 涵秋馆, 蔚藻堂, 中和堂, 敷春堂 and 心镜轩 have service buildings on them, and 含晖楼, 澄心堂, 延寿寺, 清夏堂 and 喜雨山房 are occupied by other institutions. 澹泊宁静 and several others have been dug since, so this is out of date for them.

evidence.title: 张宝章: Qichun Yuan under Jiaqing and Daoguang
evidence.summary: Axis from the great gate in the south-east: 勤政殿, 中和堂, 敷春堂, up to 问月楼 on the lake shore. In the north a large water split by a causeway, with 凤麟洲 on an island in the east part; south of the small western lake 展诗应律, 庄严法界, 生冬室, 春泽斋, 四宜书屋. On two southern islands 畅和堂 and 绿满轩, with 澄心堂 between 畅和堂 and 正觉寺. This also gives QC09 庄严法界 a rough position (Q11).

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 春泽斋
evidence.summary: Seven spring poems, 1802-1819, nearly all on rain and the wheat; the name itself is about spring rain, and they say almost nothing on the hall's form. 春泽斋: 7 dated items, 1802-1819, of which 7 poems (Jiaqing); recurring themes: the view, state papers, the harvest. First dated 1802, last dated 1819.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 春泽斋
evidence.summary: Built in mid-Jiaqing west of 展诗应律: a seven-bay hall with front and rear annexes, and 水心榭, a three-bay open hall on the pool. East of it are courts with 畅惠轩, 蘋香沜, 茂悦精舍 and 惠圃; across the pool stands the three-bay 时登楼.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
